front.label: Front
front.desc: Your name, your number out of 25 and the two brands, set inside a Hyperliquid shape written in the HYPE genesis record.

front.label: Name
front.desc: Your .hl or .eth name, etched and filled in Hyperliquid mint.

front.label: Brands
front.desc: Hyperliquid India and ENS, the official wordmarks in white.

front.label: Genesis fill
front.desc: The Hyperliquid shape is written in the HYPE genesis record. HYPERLIQUID, INDIA and ENS are always whole words.

front.label: Hyperliquid line
front.desc: Hyperliquid terms in dimmed mint beside the name: HyperCore, HyperEVM, HyperBFT, HIP-3, HIP-4.

back.label: Back
back.desc: A dense record: the HYPE genesis, the onchain identity behind your name, and the event. Nothing from the front but the two marks.

back.label: Genesis record
back.desc: Date, unix time, token ID, supply, distribution, wallets and the assistance fund of the HYPE genesis.

back.label: QR
back.desc: Scan or tap to open the card page and verify the holder onchain.

back.label: Onchain identity
back.desc: The registry, the .hl root, the namehash that is unique to this card, and the network it lives on.

back.label: The event
back.desc: Claim window, the unveiling at House of HYPE in Mumbai, how the card is built, and the run size.

back.label: Brands
back.desc: Hyperliquid India and ENS. The only element shared with the front.
